title: Is it AI? Is it not AI?
summary: The introduction of AI, its meteoric rise, and the pervasive presence in the digital spaces had teens excited at first, then confused, and now, has them questioning the authenticity of things left and right. Some share their feelings here and it seems there is no losing control just yet.
llm_summary: The surge of AI into everyday digital life initially thrilled teens, but as the technology proliferated it left many feeling bewildered and questioning the authenticity of what they encounter online. Their mixed reactions—ranging from excitement to doubt—highlight a growing uncertainty about how much control they truly have over AI‑driven content. This tension underscores the broader conversation about trust and transparency in an AI‑saturated world.
